metadata.title: S&P 500's top gainers include travel and food stocks, and this oil stock - MarketWatch

content.text:
8 hours ago
S&P 500's top gainers include travel and food stocks, and this oil stock
The stock market's rally, coupled with the drop in oil prices, is providing a lift to shares of a number of consumer-facing companies. But the S&P 500's top gainer is the stock of an oil-services company, Baker Hughes — even though the energy sector was the weakest sector.
Among the index's best performers are shares of Tyson Foods, DoorDash and Carvana. Also getting a nice lift are shares of trading platforms like Robinhood and Coinbase.
Meanwhile, Baker Hughes's stock is surging after the company reported second-quarter results on Sunday that beat expectations by a wide margin.
